name: Solenne Atelier Voidmarrow Couture Shroud II
description:
Designer Yseult Okafor-Brennan's second Voidmarrow piece: a full-length sculptural shroud in hand-woven carbon-silk that absorbs 99.4% of ambient light, making the wearer appear as a human-shaped void. The only visible elements are a single asymmetric panel of raw, unhemmed ivory silk cascading from the left shoulder and a collar built from cast black-glass fragments set in platinum wire — individually sourced from the ruins of pre-GLMZ Chicago. The shroud is cut to accommodate a full spinal rig with dramatic architectural effect, the rig's chrome spine reading as intentional backbone through the void-fabric.

One piece exists. It was shown once at Spire Gala 2199 and has not been seen since.
functionality: Carbon-silk provides near-total light absorption for dramatic visual effect; architectural spinal-rig channel built into back construction; platinum collar is structurally load-bearing to support glass weight.
what_it_says: Wealth so absolute it becomes absence — this is what it looks like when someone buys the right to disappear.
manufacturer: Solenne Atelier (Yseult Okafor-Brennan, Spire-level haute couture)
story_hooks: The shroud has gone missing from its owner's Spire vault — it's not the theft that's alarming, it's that the security footage shows the thief wearing it and becoming literally invisible on every camera.
Okafor-Brennan refuses to authenticate a piece currently being auctioned as the original Voidmarrow II — but the buyer insists it's real and has the documentation to prove it.
Someone photographed the shroud being worn at a the Gray Zone protest march; the image has gone viral and neither the designer nor the Tier 5 owner will comment.
related_entities: Tessera Corponation Neuroshock Suppression Patch — 'The Pall'

physical_description.visual_profile: A haunting silhouette that reads as absence rather than presence—a human-shaped void in motion. The wearer becomes a negative space, with only the asymmetric ivory silk panel and glass-fragment collar articulating the void's edges. The spinal rig's chrome becomes the body's only metallic 'skeleton' visible through the darkness.
physical_description.fit: Sculptural and architectural; engineered to drape over a full spinal rig with dramatic openness at the back, allowing the augmentation's geometry to become part of the design. Loose through the torso, deliberately formless to maximize the void effect.
physical_description.primary_material: Hand-woven carbon-silk composite (proprietary Solenne Atelier blend)—light-absorbing to 99.4% efficacy
physical_description.texture: Carbon-silk reads as matte and dense to the eye, but with microscopic woven texture that shifts barely perceptibly in direct light. The ivory raw-silk panel is soft and deliberately unhemmed, with visible weave irregularities. Black-glass collar fragments are smooth, cool, and catch light as fractured planes.
physical_description.color_scheme: Absolute black void fabric; stark raw ivory asymmetric panel; charcoal-black cast glass fragments set in platinum wire; chrome spinal rig gleaming through the darkness
physical_description.closures: None visible—the shroud drapes and settles; integration with the spinal rig acts as its anchor point
distinctive_features: Asymmetric single panel of unhemmed ivory silk cascading from left shoulder
Collar constructed from individually sourced black-glass fragments from pre-GLMZ Chicago ruins
Platinum wire setting for each glass piece
Engineered accommodation for full spinal rig with dramatic architectural effect
Chrome spinal column reads as intentional skeletal element through void-fabric
Worn once at Spire Gala 2199; provenance shrouded in mystery
physical_description.tier_indicator: Spire-level Tier 1 luxury—exclusive enough to transcend normal wealth signaling into pure artistic statement
physical_description.cultural_context: Statement of radical individualism and corpo-elite artistic patronage. Wearing this signals access to bespoke haute couture at the highest echelon, combined with the physical augmentation to justify its architectural cut. The void effect suggests philosophical depth, mystique, and a wearer comfortable being unknowable. Associated with Solenne Atelier's collector clientele.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine—this is a conservation-level piece. Any wear would diminish its conceptual power as a void. Likely stored in climate-controlled archival conditions when not displayed.
